data.notes: September is anchored by Labor Day jazz and metro-area festival programming, with larger amphitheater and arena tours filling the back half of the month.

events.title: Detroit Jazz Festival
events.summary: The free Detroit Jazz Festival is confirmed for Sept. 4-7 at Hart Plaza. The announced 2026 partial lineup includes Joe Lovano projects, Ron Carter & Foursight, Bob James, Ravi Coltrane Quartet, Artemis, Kurt Elling & Yellowjackets, Cindy Blackman Santana, and more.

events.title: Michigan Lottery Arts, Beats & Eats
events.summary: The metro-Detroit Labor Day weekend festival is confirmed for Sept. 4-7 in downtown Royal Oak. The event bills more than 200 bands on nine stages alongside art and food programming.

events.title: Justin Moore
events.summary: Country artist Justin Moore is confirmed at The Aretha Franklin Amphitheatre on Friday, Sept. 4 at 8:00 PM. The show is part of The Aretha’s 2026 weekend concert slate.

events.title: Dwele
events.venueName: Sound Board at MotorCity Casino Hotel
events.summary: Detroit R&B and neo-soul artist Dwele is confirmed at Sound Board at MotorCity Casino Hotel on Thursday, Sept. 10 at 8:00 PM. Ticketmaster lists Dwele as the lineup for the event.

events.title: Lily Allen
events.summary: Lily Allen is confirmed at the Fox Theatre on Saturday, Sept. 12 at 8:00 PM. The date appears on 313 Presents’ official Fox Theatre event calendar.

events.title: Breaking Benjamin with Chevelle, Starset & Kami Kehoe
events.summary: Breaking Benjamin’s 2026 North American tour is confirmed for Pine Knob Music Theatre on Sunday, Sept. 13 at 6:00 PM. Support is listed as Chevelle, Starset, and Kami Kehoe.

events.title: $uicideboy$ — Grey Day Tour 2026
events.summary: $uicideboy$ bring the Grey Day Tour 2026 to Pine Knob Music Theatre on Tuesday, Sept. 15 at 6:30 PM. Support is confirmed as Destroy Lonely, Shakewell, DRAIN, Black Kray, and $lim Gucci.

events.title: Social Distortion with Descendents & The Chats
events.summary: Social Distortion is confirmed at The Fillmore Detroit on Thursday, Sept. 17 at 6:30 PM. Live Nation lists Descendents and The Chats on the bill.

events.title: BABYMETAL with Halestorm & Violent Vira
events.summary: BABYMETAL’s World Tour 2026 is confirmed for Pine Knob Music Theatre on Friday, Sept. 18 at 7:20 PM. The official 313 Presents page lists Halestorm and Violent Vira as special guests.

events.title: The Hayley Williams Show with Magdalena Bay & Rico Nasty
events.summary: The Hayley Williams Show is confirmed at Pine Knob Music Theatre on Saturday, Sept. 19 at 7:00 PM. Support is listed as Magdalena Bay and Rico Nasty.

events.title: Weezer: The Gathering with The Shins & Silversun Pickups
events.summary: Weezer’s arena tour “Weezer: The Gathering” is confirmed at Little Caesars Arena on Wednesday, Sept. 23 at 7:00 PM. The Shins and Silversun Pickups are confirmed as special guests.

events.title: Logic & G-Eazy — The Endless Summer Part II
events.summary: Logic and G-Eazy’s co-headlining “The Endless Summer Part II” is confirmed for Pine Knob Music Theatre on Wednesday, Sept. 23 at 7:00 PM. Juicy J is listed as the special guest.
